activities.name: Uluwatu Temple Kecak Fire Dance
activities.description: Watch the hypnotic Kecak fire dance performed at sunset on the edge of a dramatic clifftop temple, surrounded by wild macaques and crashing ocean waves 70 meters below — one of Bali's most iconic experiences.

activities.name: USAT Liberty Wreck Scuba Dive
activities.description: Shore-enter one of the world's most accessible and spectacular wreck dives — a WWII American cargo ship now encrusted in coral and teeming with macro life, pygmy seahorses, and massive bumphead parrotfish schools.
activities.duration_note: Half-day, 2 dives including gear and guide

activities.name: Mount Batur Sunrise Trek
activities.description: Set off at 2 AM to hike Bali's most active volcano, reaching the caldera rim as a blazing sunrise ignites above a sea of clouds — with a steaming vent to cook eggs in volcanic heat and panoramic views over Lake Batur below.
activities.duration_note: Starts at 2:00 AM, returns by mid-morning

activities.name: Nusa Penida West Coast Exploration
activities.description: Take a fast boat to Nusa Penida to stand on the famous Kelingking T-Rex cliff viewpoint, swim through the naturally carved Broken Beach arch, and float in the crystal tidal pool of Angel's Billabong.
activities.duration_note: Full day from Bali including fast boats and private driver

activities.name: Mount Rinjani Summit Trek
activities.description: Conquer Indonesia's second-highest volcano on a life-changing multi-day expedition — camping on the crater rim above clouds, descending into the caldera to soak in hot springs beside an emerald crater lake, then summiting at 3,726 meters.
activities.duration_note: 3 days / 2 nights, full porter and guide package

activities.name: Babi Guling Balinese Spit-Roast Feast
activities.description: Devour Bali's most celebrated dish — whole spit-roasted pig marinated overnight in the complex basa gede spice paste of turmeric, galangal, and kaffir lime. The crispy crackling is extraordinary. Best at Babi Guling Ibu Oka in Ubud.

activities.name: Ayam Taliwang & Pelecing Kangkung Dinner
activities.description: Taste Lombok's fiery signature dish — small free-range chicken grilled and smothered in a searingly hot sambal of shrimp paste and bird's eye chilies, served alongside Pelecing Kangkung water spinach in a bright, acidic chili dressing.

activities.name: Savaya or The Lawn Beach Club
activities.description: Experience Bali's legendary beach club scene — Savaya at Uluwatu for a dramatic cliffside infinity pool overlooking the Indian Ocean, or The Lawn in Canggu for a more laid-back grass terrace vibe with sunset DJ sets and premium cocktails.

activities.name: Canggu Sand Bar & Surf Bar Crawl
activities.description: Hit Canggu's gritty, social bar strip — live acoustic sets at Luigi's on Monday nights, cheap Bintang beers at Sand Bar with a mixed surf crowd, and late-night dancing at one of the open-air clubs lining Batu Bolong Beach Road.

activities.name: Borobudur Temple Sunrise Climb
activities.description: Climb the world's largest Buddhist temple at sunrise — ascending through nine stacked stone terraces representing the Buddhist cosmology, past 2,672 relief panels, to stand among the iconic bell-shaped stupas at the summit.
activities.duration_note: Strict timed sessions — must pre-book online 3-7 days in advance; daily cap of ~1,200 visitors

activities.name: Prambanan Hindu Temple Complex
activities.description: Walk among the towering 9th-century spires of the largest Hindu temple complex in Southeast Asia — three massive central towers dedicated to Brahma, Vishnu, and Shiva rising 47 meters above the volcanic plain.

activities.name: Mount Bromo Sea of Sand Jeep & Crater Sunrise
activities.description: Blast across a vast volcanic sand sea in a 4x4 Jeep at 3 AM, climbing to a viewpoint as dawn turns the sky pink over the smoking Bromo crater — a completely otherworldly Martian landscape unlike anything else on Earth.
activities.duration_note: Starts at 3:00 AM, includes park entry and shared Jeep

activities.name: Ijen Crater Blue Flame Midnight Hike
activities.description: Hike into the caldera of Kawah Ijen at midnight to witness the rare electric-blue sulfuric flames burning at the crater floor — one of only two places on Earth where this phenomenon occurs — then watch dawn reveal a turquoise acid lake.
activities.duration_note: Starts at midnight. Gas mask rental mandatory — do not enter crater floor with cloth mask

activities.name: Tumpak Sewu Waterfall Canyon Trek
activities.description: Trek into a dramatic volcanic canyon surrounded on all sides by a semi-circular curtain of hundreds of individual waterfalls cascading down sheer green cliff faces — known as the Niagara of Java and one of Indonesia's most stunning natural sights.
activities.duration_note: Full day from Malang. Mandatory canyon guide required for descent

activities.name: Gudeg Yu Djum Traditional Jackfruit Stew
activities.description: Taste Yogyakarta's beloved signature dish at the city's most legendary gudeg kitchen — young jackfruit slow-stewed for hours in coconut milk and palm sugar until tender and sweet, served with spiced chicken, hard-boiled egg, and crispy krecek skin.

activities.name: Soto Ayam Lamongan Street Bowl
activities.description: Slurp East Java's iconic comfort food — a golden turmeric-spiced chicken soup poured over glass noodles and shredded chicken, finished with koya powder (fried garlic and prawn cracker dust) that melts into the broth.

activities.name: Malioboro Street Buskers & Prawirotaman Bar Night
activities.description: Spend the evening on Malioboro Street listening to traditional live buskers and street performers, then move to Prawirotaman Road's social bar strip — rooftop drinks at Agenda Rooftop or cocktails at Mojo Lounge in Yogyakarta's artsy quarter.

activities.name: East Java Speakeasy & Live Music Scene
activities.description: Discover East Java's thriving urban nightlife — sleek speakeasies like The Social House in Surabaya, or catch high-energy live alternative bands and indie sets at the hipster coffee compound scene growing across Malang.

activities.name: Gunung Leuser Orangutan Trek
activities.description: Trek deep into one of the world's last intact equatorial rainforests with certified guides to encounter wild and semi-wild Sumatran orangutans, Thomas leaf monkeys, and hornbills — camping overnight in the jungle and rafting back on inner tubes.
activities.duration_note: 2 days / 1 night including permits, jungle camping, meals, guides, and river raft return

activities.name: Lake Toba Kayaking & Samosir Island Exploration
activities.description: Kayak and explore Samosir Island inside the world's largest volcanic crater lake — a caldera so vast it contains its own island, its own lake, and the heartland of Batak culture, with traditional tombs, stone chairs, and highland villages.

activities.name: Mount Sibayak Active Volcano Hike
activities.description: Hike up an accessible, actively hissing geothermal volcano above the cool Karo Highlands, navigating sulfur vents and volcanic rock fields to the steaming crater rim — finishing with a soak in the hot springs at the mountain base.
activities.duration_note: Entry IDR 25,000; guide optional at IDR 300,000

activities.name: Mentawai Islands Surf Camp
activities.description: Live aboard a surf charter boat or stay at a remote surf camp to ride some of the world's most consistent and powerful reef breaks — HT's, Macaronis, Lance's Right — in an untouched archipelago off Sumatra's west coast. For intermediate to advanced surfers.
activities.duration_note: 7 to 10 day all-inclusive boat or land surf camp packages

activities.name: Kerinci Seblat National Park Wilderness Expedition
activities.description: Venture deep into one of Southeast Asia's largest and most biodiverse national parks — tracking Sumatran tiger footprints, spotting sun bears and tapir, and summiting Mt. Kerinci, the highest volcano in Indonesia.
activities.duration_note: 4 days / 3 nights, specialized wilderness expedition with ranger guides

activities.name: Nasi Padang Feast
activities.description: Experience Indonesia's most celebrated culinary tradition — a dozen small plates stacked across your table at a Rumah Makan Padang, including the legendary slow-cooked Rendang beef, Gulai Ayam coconut curry, and green chili sambal. You pay only for what you eat.

activities.name: Mie Aceh Spiced Noodle Bowl
activities.description: Slurp a steaming bowl of Mie Aceh — thick yellow noodles drenched in a rich curry-like gravy deeply spiced with cloves, cumin, and star anise, served with crab or beef and a wedge of lime. A powerful, aromatic dish unique to Aceh.

activities.name: Samosir Island Batak Acoustic Fireside Night
activities.description: Gather around a lakeside fire at Roy's Pub or Sam's Bungalow on Samosir Island for cold Bintangs and live Batak acoustic music — local singers performing hauntingly beautiful multi-part harmonies that carry across the still volcanic lake at night.

activities.name: Komodo Phinisi Liveaboard Cruise
activities.description: Sleep aboard a traditional wooden Phinisi sailing vessel as it glides between Komodo's islands — waking up anchored off Padar Island at sunrise, snorkeling with manta rays, trekking with Komodo dragons, and swimming on Pink Beach.
activities.duration_note: 3 days / 2 nights, deluxe shared cabin. Park entry IDR 650,000/day extra. Must pre-book — hard cap of 1,000 visitors/day

activities.name: Padar Island Summit Trek & Pink Beach
activities.description: Hike the steep switchback trail to the famous Padar Island summit for a jaw-dropping three-bay panorama — three different colored beaches curving below — then descend to swim on one of the world's only volcanic pink sand beaches.
activities.duration_note: Typically included in liveaboard packages. Park entry fee IDR 650,000/day for foreigners

activities.name: Manta Point & Castle Rock Drift Dives
activities.description: Drift through the powerful, nutrient-rich currents of Komodo to fly alongside dozens of giant reef manta rays at Manta Point, then tackle the exhilarating Castle Rock — one of the most adrenaline-charged drift dives in the world.
activities.duration_note: Full day, 3 dives. Minimum 30 logged dives required — currents are extremely powerful

activities.name: Kelimutu Tri-Colored Volcanic Lakes
activities.description: Hike to the summit of Kelimutu volcano at dawn to witness three crater lakes — each a completely different color due to shifting mineral and gas compositions — ranging from turquoise to blood red to jet black as the seasons change.

activities.name: Wae Rebo Traditional Village Trek
activities.description: Hike 9km through dense mountain jungle to reach the remote, UNESCO-recognized Wae Rebo — a village of seven magnificent cone-shaped Mbaru Niang houses perched at 1,200 meters, where the Manggarai people maintain their ancestral way of life completely intact.
activities.duration_note: 2 days / 1 night including local transport, certified guide, and traditional homestay

activities.name: Kampung Ujung Waterfront Seafood Grill
activities.description: Walk the Labuan Bajo night market waterfront, pick your own wild-caught red snapper, tiger prawns, or calamari from ice displays, then watch it grilled over glowing coconut husks with sweet soy and sambal as fishing boats bob in the harbor.

activities.name: Se'i Sapi Flores Smoked Beef
activities.description: Try Flores' signature smoked beef dish — thinly sliced Se'i Sapi smoked low and slow over Kosambi wood until richly flavored, served with a fiery Sambal Lu'at made from citrus leaves and local chilies. A profoundly aromatic regional specialty.

activities.name: Le Pirate Rooftop & Loccal Cliffside Bar
activities.description: Labuan Bajo's best night spots — Le Pirate Boathouse for acoustic sets, movie nights, and cold drinks over the harbor, or the upscale Loccal Collection cliffside lounge for sunset DJ sets with a Santorini-like view across the island-dotted bay.
